decisions.reason: Premium customer support is closely tied to the firm's core hosting and service knowledge, so with its own R&D and growing team it can keep improving and integrating this offer.

The software version management tool builds directly on the firm's established platform, security, and website administration capabilities, which gives strong absorptive capacity for further development and commercial use.

The data processing contract tool is comparatively distant from the firm's core hosting and operational know-how, so even with in-house R&D the firm is less able to learn from it and is more likely to reallocate resources to closer activities.
Scalable hosting for agencies is highly consistent with the firm's main customer base, infrastructure, and technical expertise, making it a natural product to retain and deepen.
